lxc_01f980165dce38de.text: Hobbies and weekend events give people friendly things to share.

lxc_79b06d6be7fa0e15.text: Daily conversation is easy talk at work or home.

lxc_4c19db023c213ec5.text: What people talk about in daily life is hobbies.

lxc_52257c196a04919e.text: Small talk is short, polite talk.

lxc_2136d448f3a7627a.text: It helps people feel at ease.

lxc_076e78b5efdf74a6.text: Safe topics include weather, food, sports, and hobbies.

lxc_70ffd757cbfc74ad.text: Weekend plans are also easy to share.

lxc_d79b2c908a50e94c.text: Bronislaw Malinowski wrote about this kind of talk in 1923.

lxc_beab807c5753ea0f.text: He said it helps people stay friendly.

lxc_70f31106f26772bb.text: We can notice three things: the topic, the time, and the friendly reason.

lxc_12155472b29d1192.text: NPB is Japan's top baseball league.

lxc_e6a8cd43cb957fe6.text: People often talk about a weekend NPB game.

lxc_e06486e5d2645af4.text: Ichiro Suzuki set a record of 262 hits in 2004.

lxc_fb8941815abf2d37.text: A great player can give fans a fun topic.

lxc_fc939c6cd2f98464.text: Friends often rent a small karaoke box by the hour.

lxc_9569db7d963d7426.text: They can sing together after work or on a weekend.

lxc_09eed093c5510b42.text: A weekend trip can also become a talk topic.

lxc_bf3108716ddd2e09.text: Ueno Park has over 1,000 cherry trees.

lxc_be4a4bcf367ac9e8.text: The trees bloom in late March and early April.

lxc_91af18c3103ec939.text: People have a picnic under them.

lxc_8973a3e35e2ddace.text: Hot springs give people another trip idea.

lxc_1216c6c3c764e150.text: Dogo Onsen is one of the oldest onsen.

lxc_1c24f090d1d2daed.text: After the trip, people can share what they saw and did.

lxc_3be72e02c375a18c.text: Football gives many people a shared topic.

lxc_2e7b2360d739d1b1.text: Monday talk can follow a weekend match.

lxc_ca8168653e9e0cbf.text: FC Bayern Munich has 31 league titles.

lxc_34a9bb561e565ea4.text: In Spain, cafe talk often follows a big game.

lxc_855f1b4913be8b28.text: El Clasico is a famous football match.

lxc_02e5ef5d8b514405.text: Lionel Messi scored 26 goals in this match.

lxc_619d30440f2699bb.text: Like baseball talk in Japan, football talk can make Monday chat easy.

lxc_915d58273122199d.text: Outdoor hobbies can give people new stories.

lxc_fbd238e506194855.text: Switzerland has more than 65,000 kilometres of marked hiking trails.

lxc_2858a02c71bf66a4.text: About 2.7 million people there hike often.

lxc_3d1b70af7a7013e7.text: Yellow Wanderweg signs show walking time.

lxc_8ffc4d825d7d43a0.text: Many trails go through the Alps.

lxc_735d306415570fce.text: A Sunday hike can become a Monday story.

lxc_00eb5fe5767dc8d4.text: In Japan, a weekend onsen trip can do the same job.

lxc_4e4ac99ac7b11b45.text: The place is different, but the friendly reason is the same.

lxc_b2931ea902d3a13a.text: In the USA, many people watch American football.

lxc_47fbf84626229288.text: Thanksgiving is on the fourth Thursday of November.

lxc_8397f4972af39673.text: Families often watch NFL games that weekend.

lxc_b7db70b51b4e3f9a.text: The Super Bowl is the last pro football game of the year.

lxc_8f5130532b429a0e.text: A listed TV record for it is 127.7 million viewers.

lxc_6732cb5908a6d654.text: These events give many people the same topic at the same time.

lxc_2bd30348a504e2bd.text: Shared time makes small talk easier.
